label: PF Backlog 589
title: dogfood/validation: ensure DOGFOOD-profile quality_gate record so PASS is reachable
body:
## Problem / why
run_quality_gate only records for item/amend modes; validation_engine._ensure_quality_gate is called only by
feature_pr. So the DOGFOOD profile's quality_gate check is 'unknown' -> BLOCKED -> never PASS.

## Goal / value
Make the DOGFOOD profile produce/ensure the quality-gate record for the validated tree (reuse the existing owner).

## In scope
- Ensure quality-gate record before DOGFOOD validation (edit existing owners; no new store).

## Out of scope
- Weakening fail-closed semantics; changing other profiles.

## Acceptance criteria
- After a successful build, DOGFOOD validation can return PASS (quality_gate check resolves).

## Verification / test plan
- Unit: DOGFOOD profile on a tree with a quality-gate record -> check pass; without -> unchanged fail-closed.
